ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Expiration_Date__c)), Expiration_Date__c < TODAY(), NOT(Finance_Exception_Approved__c), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Validated"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Reserved"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Applied to Quote") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Expired vouchers cannot be validated, reserved, or applied to quote unless an exception is approved.
